hazards.label: Haze
hazards.reading: Highest 24-hour PSI of the day in the region
hazards.source: NEA 24-hour PSI by region, Apr 2014 to Nov 2026 (NEA historical 24-hour PSI, the real-time feed after it ends on 1 Oct 2026). Band levels are the NEA PSI bands. Severities are a starting assumption.

hazards.label: Heavy rain
hazards.reading: Rain in the wettest work hour at the nearest gauge, mm
hazards.source: NEA rain gauges, Dec 2016 to Nov 2026, work hours 7am to 7pm. Severities are a starting assumption.

hazards.label: Heat
hazards.reading: Work hours with WBGT at 32°C or more at the nearest station
hazards.source: NEA WBGT stations, Jan 2025 to Nov 2026. 32°C is the MOM rest-break level. Severities are a starting assumption. In 2026 S142 had 120 days with 2 or more work hours at WBGT 32°C and S128 50, against about 7 at the median station (data/processed/day_readings.csv.gz): both are on hold, and the next nearest station is read, until NEA confirms them.

hazards.label: Flash flood
hazards.reading: 1 if a PUB flood alert covers the site, else 0
hazards.source: No flood history in the repo yet. Priced at 0 days a year until PUB flood records are added.

hazards.label: Closure order
hazards.reading: 1 if a government order closes the business for the day, else 0
hazards.source: No history. A closure stops all sales, so it pays the full tier payout. Priced as one 40-day lockdown or closure order every 20 years (2 days a year), a team assumption until Income gives its view. Every tier pays up to 45 days a year, so a 40-day lockdown is paid in full.

products.label: Cooked food
products.source: Margin 0.67: SingStat Annual Survey of Services 2024, food and beverage services (SSIC 56) spent 32.9% of operating revenue on goods and materials (data.gov.sg d_38d62de582eb7ee2c58d1bba4cd4132d, d_4eb10d0ef99e56c2336c37d78b10c6bc). A cooked meal not sold today is not sold later. Demand lost and sales recovered are starting assumptions until we have sales data.

products.label: Fresh produce, meat and seafood
products.source: Margin 0.32: SingStat Annual Survey of Services 2024, retail trade (SSIC 47) spent 68.0% of operating revenue on goods and materials (same datasets). Demand lost and sales recovered are starting assumptions until we have sales data.

products.label: Flowers and plants
products.source: Margin 0.32: SingStat Annual Survey of Services 2024, retail trade (SSIC 47) spent 68.0% of operating revenue on goods and materials (same datasets). Demand lost and sales recovered are starting assumptions until we have sales data.

products.label: Packaged food and drinks
products.source: Margin 0.32: SingStat Annual Survey of Services 2024, retail trade (SSIC 47) spent 68.0% of operating revenue on goods and materials (same datasets). Demand lost and sales recovered are starting assumptions until we have sales data.

products.label: Clothing and general goods
products.source: Margin 0.32: SingStat Annual Survey of Services 2024, retail trade (SSIC 47) spent 68.0% of operating revenue on goods and materials (same datasets). Demand lost and sales recovered are starting assumptions until we have sales data.

products.label: Ride-hail and delivery work
products.source: Ride-hail and delivery work under a platform work agreement (Platform Workers Act 2024, MOM). No stock, so shelf life is 0 and nothing spoils; restocking does not count. Margin 0.7 (the share of a fare or delivery fee the worker keeps after the platform commission and fuel), demand lost 0.6 and nothing recovered (a lost hour of work is not made up later) are starting assumptions until we have earnings data.

haze_bonus.source: 40 or more days at PSI 101+ in a region: 2015 only in Apr 2014 to Nov 2026, in 3 of 5 regions. Priced as about 1 in 18 years: 0.60 / (1.09 x 10) = 5.5% a year. Team assumption until a longer haze record is checked.

rent.source: NEA successful tender bids for cooked-food stalls, Jan 2019 to Jul 2026, median per centre over the bids since Aug 2023. The limits split the 81 centres with a bid into thirds, rounded. 26 trading days a month (one rest day a week) is an assumption.
